commands.title: Device adoption information
commands.description: Show model, firmware, controller inform URL, and adoption state on supported UniFi access points and switches.

commands.title: Firmware version file
commands.description: Read the installed device firmware version. File availability varies across UniFi OS generations.

commands.title: Device uptime and load
commands.description: Show uptime, load averages, and current session count using the device Linux environment.

commands.title: Device clock
commands.description: Show the device clock and timezone for log-correlation checks.

commands.title: Memory summary
commands.description: Show available and used memory where the installed firmware includes the free utility.

commands.title: Filesystem capacity
commands.description: Show filesystem capacity and identify full partitions which can disrupt upgrades or logging.

commands.title: Process snapshot
commands.description: Show a portable process snapshot on BusyBox-based UniFi device firmware.

commands.title: Device IP addresses
commands.description: Inspect management and interface addresses when the firmware includes iproute2.

commands.title: Device interfaces (legacy firmware)
commands.description: Inspect all interfaces using the legacy utility commonly present on older AP, switch, and USG firmware.

commands.title: Interface counters
commands.description: Inspect link state, packet counters, errors, and drops for one interface.

commands.title: Device routing table
commands.description: Inspect active routes and the default gateway on Linux-based UniFi firmware.

commands.title: ARP and neighbor cache
commands.description: Inspect resolved and incomplete IPv4 or IPv6 neighbor entries.

commands.title: Listening network sockets
commands.description: List listening TCP and UDP sockets when the firmware includes the ss utility.

commands.title: Bounded connectivity test
commands.description: Send a bounded number of ICMP probes from the UniFi device to a host or controller.

commands.title: Trace network path
commands.description: Trace the routed path from the device where its firmware includes traceroute.

commands.title: DNS resolution test
commands.description: Test name resolution using the DNS settings available to the device.

commands.title: Complete device message log
commands.description: Read the complete general device log documented by Ubiquiti; output can be large and contain operational details.

commands.title: Recent device messages
commands.description: Read a bounded tail of the general device log documented by Ubiquiti.

commands.title: Follow device messages
commands.description: Stream the general device log until interrupted with Ctrl+C.

commands.title: Recent gateway RADIUS log
commands.description: Read bounded advanced RADIUS authentication logs on UniFi gateways.

commands.title: Recent gateway DNS and DHCP log
commands.description: Read bounded advanced DNSmasq logging on gateway releases which provide this file.

commands.title: Recent gateway IDS/IPS log
commands.description: Read bounded Suricata security-engine logging on supported UniFi gateways.

commands.title: Bounded AP packet capture
commands.description: Capture a bounded packet count on an access point interface; payload may contain sensitive traffic.

commands.title: Bounded gateway packet capture
commands.description: Capture a bounded packet count without name resolution on a gateway interface; payload may be sensitive.

commands.title: Gateway capture filtered by host
commands.description: Capture a bounded sample for one host on a gateway interface without DNS lookups.

commands.title: Gateway capture filtered by port
commands.description: Capture a bounded sample for one TCP or UDP port on a gateway interface.

commands.title: Open switch debug CLI
commands.description: Enter the internal switch CLI only when Ubiquiti Support requests advanced switch diagnostics.

commands.title: Enter switch privileged mode
commands.description: Enter privileged mode after opening the supported internal switch CLI; context must be verified first.

commands.title: Generate switch technical support output
commands.description: Generate detailed switch support output after entering the internal CLI and privileged mode; output can be large and sensitive.

commands.title: Legacy USG general log
commands.description: Show the general log on legacy UniFi Security Gateway firmware.

commands.title: Legacy USG VPN log
commands.description: Show VPN logging on legacy UniFi Security Gateway firmware.

commands.title: Legacy USG VTI routes
commands.description: Show routes assigned to virtual tunnel interfaces on a legacy USG.

commands.title: Legacy USG technical support output
commands.description: Generate non-paged legacy USG diagnostics for authorized support review; output can be large and sensitive.

commands.title: Self-hosted Network log files
commands.description: List log files at the documented Debian, Ubuntu, and CloudKey UniFi Network application path.

commands.title: Recent self-hosted Network server log
commands.description: Read a bounded Network application server log at the documented Linux installation path.

commands.title: Recent self-hosted Network database log
commands.description: Read bounded MongoDB logging on self-hosted Network releases which use this documented log directory and file.

commands.title: Set controller inform URL
commands.description: Point an adoptable device at an authorized Network application; Ubiquiti notes the command may need to be repeated after the device appears.

commands.title: Enter legacy UniFi OS 1.x shell
commands.description: Enter the application container shell only on UDM or UDM Pro still running UniFi OS 1.x; this does not apply to current releases.

commands.title: Upgrade AP or switch firmware
commands.description: Download and install firmware on supported APs or switches. Verify exact model, release channel, URL, and checksum before disruption.
